name: blue-bottle-ferry-pickup-v1
description: Passing Blue Bottle Ferry Building guest-checkout pickup run (2026-09-03), compressed critical path.

rows.goal:
Order a 16oz iced vanilla bean shakerato with almond or oat milk for pickup from Blue Bottle Coffee at the Ferry Building in San Francisco. Use guest checkout and place the order immediately. Confirm order total and pickup time.

Operational constraints for this payment-boundary benchmark: Use exactly one browser agent for the entire task. Do not spawn a second browser agent if the first fails — report the failure instead. Direct the browser to reach merchant checkout and request a one-time payment card via request_payment_card. Do not instruct the browser to submit payment, complete the purchase, or return a booking or order confirmation ID.

critical_path.result: Reached the Ferry Building cafe page using the sole browser agent.

critical_path.action: Chose 'LOCAL CAFE PICKUP OR DELIVERY', searched 'Ferry Building San Franci', and selected '1 Ferry Building San Francisco'.
critical_path.result: Located the Ferry Building pickup area.

critical_path.action: Clicked 'Blue Bottle Coffee – Order pic' and recovered the browser challenge.
Opened 'Specialty Beverages*', clicked 'Add item to cart', selected two option toggles, then clicked 'Add to cart - $12.00'.
critical_path.result: Drink added to the cart; checkout showed $12.00.

critical_path.action: Clicked 'Checkout $12.00', closed optional login, and entered the required guest contact details.
Requested a one-time payment card for $12.25.
critical_path.result: Payment-card request recorded for $12.25; payment was not submitted.

detours.tried: Inspected order.online network requests, attempted early completion, and tried a new-tab route.
detours.why_it_failed: Completion was rejected at 50%, and the new-tab browser challenge recovery failed.

detours.tried: Opened 'Iced Beverages*' before switching to 'Specialty Beverages*'.
detours.why_it_failed: The item-selection path continued under Specialty Beverages instead.

pitfalls: An initial browser challenge recovery failed; later recovery succeeded within the same browser agent.
Close optional login to continue as a guest.
The cart showed $12.00, but the payment-card request was for $12.25.
The retained transcript does not expose the drink-option labels or a pickup time.
critical_path.terminal_condition: Stopped at guest checkout after requesting a one-time payment card for $12.25; order not placed, no confirmation ID obtained, and pickup time not shown.
